facts.fact: A second cohort of 50 young people began D-CLIC digital-skills training at Aneho in August 2026, backed by nearly CFAF 300 million from OIF since 2025.
In April 2025, 244 young Togolese received certificates after five months of D-CLIC training in Lome, Aneho, Kara and Dapaong, per Togo First.

Togo's digital transformation minister launched the Campus 42 coding and AI peer-learning programme, financed by Axian Group through Yas Togo with French support, to train hundreds of young Togolese a year.

slug: 2024-12-18 Togo - $100 Million in Funding to Accelerate Digital Transformation

facts.fact: The World Bank approved a $100 million first IDA financing for Togo that, with IFC, will finance digital skills to improve employability of key population groups, especially young people and women.
